original: 本当かどうかは分かんないけど、そう言ってる人も多いよ。

en.text: I don't know if it's true, but a lot of people say it.
I don't know whether it's true, but many say so.

original: 本当かどうかわかんないけど、みんなそう言ってるよ。

en.text: I don't know if it's true, but that's what everyone's saying.

original: みんなそう言ってたよ。

en.text: Everybody said so.
That's what everyone said.

original: そう言う人もいるでしょう。

en.text: Some people would say that.

original: 私はトムに君がそう言ったって伝えるよ。

en.text: I'll tell Tom you said that.

original: トム、お前がそう言うなら。

en.text: If you say so, Tom.
